'''Tha'ross''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] salvage foreman of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] he was killed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salvage Foreman Tha'ross appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion-difficulty NPC on Ilum. Though not involved in any quests, killing him is required to complete an Imperial-side achievement.
